documentation: Two-state scenario stored in global var sc1. first -> second, then stays on second until /test/scenario-1-reset is called (does NOT loop).

body: "message": "{{#switch (getVar 'state')}}{{#case 'first'}}First call - next request will return the second state{{/case}}{{#default}}Second call - call /test/scenario-1-reset to reset back to the first state{{/default}}{{/switch}}"
